grammar_focus: KS29+KS52 三种时态综合复习:一般过去时(What happened)/ 现在完成时(What has happened)/ 现在完成进行时(What has been happening)(教材 L53 Key structures)主考;SD 易混词 throw to/at/away、quite/quiet、cause/reason、drop/fall(辅考)
scene: 消防队员们终于扑灭了加利福尼亚的一场森林大火。从那时起,他们一直试图找出起火的原因。森林火灾时常由破碎的玻璃或人们随手扔掉的香烟头引起。昨天,消防队员仔细查看了地面,但未能发现碎玻璃。他们还十分肯定火灾也不是由烟头引起的。然而今天上午,一个消防队员偶然发现了起火的原因。他发现了缠绕在 16,000 伏高压线上的一条死蛇。就这样,他解开了起火之谜。解释很简单,却异乎寻常。一只鸟把蛇从地上抓起来,然后把它扔到了电线上。于是蛇就缠住了几根电线。当它这样做时,把火花送到了地面,这些火花立刻引起了一场大火。

grammar_card.title: 三种时态综合复习:一般过去 / 现在完成 / 现在完成进行
grammar_card.intro: KS29+KS52 综合复习——What happened?(一般过去时,过去某时的动作)、What has happened?(现在完成时,已完成/曾经、对现在有影响)、What has been happening?(现在完成进行时,一段时间里一直在进行)。

rows: I stayed at this hotel five years ago.
Have you ever stayed at this hotel?
I have been staying here for three weeks.
Yesterday the firemen examined the ground.
Firemen have put out the fire.

specialRules.rule: 看时间标志选时态:five years ago / yesterday → 一般过去;ever / just / already → 现在完成;since… / for… / all morning → 现在完成进行。
SD 易混词:throw to sb(扔给某人接)/ throw at(朝…砸)/ throw away(扔掉);quite(相当)≠ quiet(安静);cause(起因)≠ reason(缘由);drop(使落下)≠ fall(落下)。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What caused the fire?
options: A snake wound round the electric wires sent sparks to the ground

passage: At last firemen have put out a big forest fire in California. Since then, they have been trying to find out how the fire began. Forest fires are often caused by broken glass or by cigarette ends which people carelessly throw away. Yesterday the firemen examined the ground carefully, but were not able to find any broken glass. They were also quite sure that a cigarette end did not start the fire. This morning, however, a fireman accidentally discovered the cause. He noticed the remains of a snake which was wound round the electric wires of a 16,000-volt power line. In this way, he was able to solve the mystery. The explanation was simple but very unusual. A bird had snatched up the snake from the ground and then dropped it on to the wires. The snake then wound itself round the wires. When it did so, it sent sparks down to the ground and these immediately started a fire.

grammar_points.name: 现在完成进行时(What has been happening)
三时态对比·看时间标志选时态
throw to / at / away 辨析(SD)

stage5.stem: "I ___ at this hotel five years ago."(一般过去时:5 年前的事)
stage5.stem_cn: 5 年前我在这家酒店住过。

stage5.stem: "Yesterday the firemen ___ the ground carefully."(一般过去时:昨天检查)
stage5.stem_cn: 昨天消防队员仔细检查了地面。

stage5.stem: "A bird ___ up the snake from the ground."(一般过去时:snatch 的过去式)
stage5.stem_cn: 一只鸟把蛇从地上抓了起来。

stage5.stem: "At last firemen ___ out a big forest fire."(现在完成时:终于扑灭了)
stage5.stem_cn: 消防队员终于扑灭了一场大火。

stage5.stem: "Have you ever ___ at this hotel?"(现在完成时:stay 的过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 你曾在这家酒店住过吗?

stage5.stem: "A fireman ___ just discovered the cause."(现在完成时:刚刚发现)
stage5.stem_cn: 一名消防员刚刚发现了起火原因。

stage5.stem: "Since then, they ___ to find out how the fire began."(现在完成进行时:一直试图)
stage5.stem_cn: 从那时起,他们一直试图找出起火原因。

stage5.stem: "I ___ at this hotel for three weeks."(现在完成进行时:一直住着)
stage5.stem_cn: 我一直住在这家酒店有 3 周了。

stage5.stem: "It ___ raining since yesterday."(现在完成进行时:一直在下)
"They ___ trying to find out the cause since then."(since then 一直:选现在完成进行时)
stage5.stem_cn: 从那时起他们一直在设法找出原因。

stage5.stem: "I ___ this film three times; I know it well."(至今看过三次:选现在完成时)
stage5.stem_cn: 这部电影我看过三遍,很熟悉。

stage5.stem: "He ___ to California last summer."(last summer 明确过去:选一般过去时)
stage5.stem_cn: 去年夏天他去了加利福尼亚。

stage5.stem: "He threw the ball ___ me and I caught it."(把球'扔给'某人接,后接介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 他把球扔给我,我接住了。

stage5.stem: "The boy threw a stone ___ the window and broke it."(朝目标'砸'东西,带攻击性)
stage5.stem_cn: 男孩朝窗户扔了块石头,把玻璃打碎了。

stage5.stem: "People carelessly throw ___ cigarette ends."(把烟头'扔掉、丢弃')
"They were ___ sure that a cigarette end did not start the fire."(相当、十分,程度副词)
stage5.stem_cn: 他们十分肯定不是烟头引起的火。

stage5.stem: "The class kept very ___ during the lesson."(安静的、寂静的)
"A bird had ___ the snake onto the wires."(把蛇'扔、抛'到电线上)
stage5.stem_cn: 一只鸟把蛇扔到了电线上。
